topic: 5 operational signals that a business is ready for AI agents

slides.hook: 5 signs your business is ready for **AI agents**

slides.title: Your team repeats itself daily
slides.body: If your people copy data between tools, answer the same questions, or file the same reports weekly — that is a workflow waiting to be automated.

slides.title: Decisions wait on data pulls
slides.body: Reports take days because someone gathers, cleans and formats by hand. An agent does it continuously — leadership decides in real time.

slides.title: Support scales with headcount
slides.body: If every new customer means another hire, margins shrink as you grow. Agents absorb volume without adding payroll.

slides.title: Your data lives in silos
slides.body: CRM, finance, ops — all disconnected. Agents work across systems, so insight stops depending on who remembered to sync what.

slides.title: Growth is throttled by ops
slides.body: Demand is not your bottleneck — capacity is. Automation turns operations from a constraint into a multiplier.

slides.line: Two of these true? Let's talk.
